Asymptotic Variance of the Mean-Time-to-Failure Estimator

Source: R/04_mttf.R
var_mttf.Rd

Computes the asymptotic variance of the plug-in estimator of the mean time to failure (MTTF) for a finite-state Markov chain.

Usage

var_mttf(x, up)

Arguments

x

An object of class MarkovChain.

up

Integer or character vector giving the up (operational) states.

Value

A numeric scalar containing the asymptotic variance \(\sigma_\psi^2\) of the MTTF estimator.

Details

Let \(\mathcal{U}\) denote the set of operational states, \(P_{\mathcal{U},\mathcal{U}}\) be the submatrix of transition probabilities between operational states, \(r=|\mathcal{U}|\), and \(N=(I_r-P_{\mathcal{U},\mathcal{U}})^{-1}\). The mean time to failure is computed as $$ \psi = a_{\mathcal{U}}^\mathsf{T} N \mathbf{1}_r, $$ where \(a_{\mathcal{U}}\) is the restriction of the initial distribution to the operational states and \(\mathbf{1}_r\) is a vector of ones.

Let \(\Sigma_{\mathcal{U}}\) be the submatrix of \(\Sigma_{\mathbf p}\) corresponding to transitions between operational states. Then: $$ \sqrt{n} \left\{ \widehat{\psi}_n-\psi \right\} \mathrel{\mathop{\longrightarrow}\limits^{d}} \mathcal{N} \left( 0, \sigma_\psi^2 \right), $$ where $$ \sigma_\psi^2 = D_\psi \Sigma_{\mathcal{U}} D_\psi^{\mathsf T}, $$ and $$ D_\psi = \left( a_{\mathcal{U}}^{\mathsf T}N \right) \mathbin{\otimes} \left( \mathbf{1}_r^{\mathsf T}N^{\mathsf T} \right). $$

The MTTF \(\psi\) is returned by mttf(). The asymptotic variance \(\sigma_\psi^2\) is returned by this function.

References

GSI

A. Sadek and N. Limnios (2002). Asymptotic properties of estimators for nonhomogeneous Markov chains. Statistics & Probability Letters, 60(4), 1839–1850. See Theorem 8 (p. 1852) for the MTTF.
